blurb: Alternative Routes offers hop-on-hop-off tours, guided day trips, and multi-day journeys in Nova Scotia. Guests can explore at their own pace, hopping off to stay overnight and rejoining the route later. The company emphasizes sustainable travel, small groups, and working with local businesses.
extraNote: Booking ahead guarantees a seat, but last-minute riders are welcome if there is room
